author: ETA PRIME
description:
Taking the Steam Machine to the next level with the newest hardware upgrade from JSAUX. In this video, we're unboxing and installing the new JSAUX Digital Faceplates, checking out both the E-Ink and Pixel Matrix display options. From booting into SteamOS desktop mode and installing the Decky Loader plugins to customizing the screen modules with real-time hardware telemetry, weather, and custom GIFs, we cover the entire setup process. We also push the system with our standard Cyberpunk 2077 benchmark to see how responsive the Pixel Matrix display is at tracking real-time GPU, CPU, and RAM usage under heavy load. If you love optimizing and customizing your small form factor setups, this is a must-have mod.
